# scm_dlp_document_type_list (Data Source)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Lists Enterprise DLP Document Types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all DLP document types in the tenant.
data "scm_dlp_document_type_list" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of document types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total` (Number) Total number of document types.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category of the document type.
- `description` (String) A description of the document type.
- `detection_technique` (String) Detection technique.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the document type.
- `l1_category_id` (Number) Level 1 Category ID.
- `l2_category_id` (Number) Level 2 Category ID.
- `name` (String) The name of the document type.
- `original_file_name` (String) Original sample file name.
- `tfid` (String) The Terraform ID.
